decisions.reason: After two years with no visible evidence of traction and only a weak fit with the firm's transport-maritime core, the option value now looks limited relative to the attention it absorbs.

Superyacht crew recruitment is still adjacent to the firm's maritime people-services capabilities, so a large firm would usually keep this relatively low-cost option open a bit longer despite limited disclosed results.
The academy was launched only in 2024 and already shows six partner institutions, so uncertainty is still resolving and the early signal is good enough to continue.
The service has already demonstrated clear customer-relevant execution against a regulatory deadline, which strongly supports retaining and scaling it.
The dashboard fits tightly with new emissions-compliance demand and is integrated into the firm's software, so it is a valuable complementary option even if adoption evidence is still early.

The cost simulation tool is strategically aligned with the same regulatory wave and software platform, and management would typically keep such an early-stage digital option open unless usage disappoints materially.
